package parsers

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// ParseCourseFilters parses course filters from query parameters with validation.
func ParseCourseFilters(r *http.Request, validator *validator.Validate) (filters.CourseFilters, error) {
	var result filters.CourseFilters

	var err error
	if result.ID, err = parseStringParam(r, "id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Slug, err = parseStringParam(r, "slug", validator, "ascii,max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	statusRule := fmt.Sprintf("oneof=%d %d %d",
		domain.CourseStatusNoActive,
		domain.CourseStatusDraft,
		domain.CourseStatusActive,
	)
	if result.Status, err = parseIntParam(r, "status", validator, statusRule); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.CatalogVisible, err = parseBoolParam(r, "catalog_visible"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Title, err = parseStringParam(r, "title", validator, "max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.TagID, err = parseIntParam(r, "tag_id", validator, "min=1"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.TagSlug, err = parseStringParam(r, "tag_slug", validator, "ascii,max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.CourseGroupID, err = parseStringParam(r, "course_group_id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.LevelID, err = parseStringParam(r, "level_id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.LevelSlug, err = parseStringParam(r, "level_slug", validator, "ascii,max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.TrackID, err = parseStringParam(r, "track_id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.TrackSlug, err = parseStringParam(r, "track_slug", validator, "ascii,max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if (result.TrackSlug == nil) != (result.LevelSlug == nil) {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, fmt.Errorf("track_slug and level_slug must be provided together")
	}
	pageRule := fmt.Sprintf("min=%d,max=%d", filters.MinPage, filters.MaxPage)
	if result.Page, err = parseIntParam(r, "page", validator, pageRule); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	limitRule := fmt.Sprintf("min=%d,max=%d", filters.MinLimit, filters.MaxLimit)
	if result.Limit, err = parseIntParam(r, "limit", validator, limitRule); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Page == nil {
		defaultPage := filters.DefaultPage
		result.Page = &defaultPage
	}
	if result.Limit == nil {
		defaultLimit := filters.DefaultLimit
		result.Limit = &defaultLimit
	}

	return result, nil
}
